title: Best guide in Spain
text: Our tour with Vladimir Ribo Argemi to Monsterrant was incredible. Vladimir is a wonderful guide and tailored our tour to our abilities. We’re an elderly couple and he was kind extremely helpful and very flexible in our itinerary.  He proposed many options and suggestions for us so we could choose what we wanted to do.  We were very fortunate to have Vladimir as our guide and wish he could accompany us on our entire journey.
author: karenbP7990KY

title: Great

title: Montserrat guide.
text: Excellent organization. The guide picked us up on time and was very attentive throughout the tour. He explained the whole tour and adapted to our requests, adapting the tour to our taste. I would definitely repeat!
author: Vacation38779314920

title: Amazing!
text: The experience was very satisfying, I went with two friends and with the guide of Barcelona Day Trip, picked us up at the agreed meeting point, was punctual and the car was in good condition, all very correct. The guide was very polite, friendly and friendly, all the time pending that we were all well, he was very attentive. We really enjoyed the visit and the explanations despite the restrictions we encountered on that day.
